newsitem.title: CROATIA: Canada interested in buying Croatian goods.
newsitem.headline: Canada interested in buying Croatian goods.

text.p: Canadian importers are interested in buying Croatian products for the North American market, the Croatian Chamber of Commerce said on Friday.
It said a Canadian delegation of businessmen from the chemical, textile, wood- and metal-processing industry met representatives of corresponding local firms to talk about possible cooperation.

The meeting opened a three-day visit initiated by the Trade Facilitation Office Canada (TFOC), whose main business is promotion of companies from developing countries, a chamber official told Reuters.

According to the state news agency Hina, "concrete business deals" were dicussed with major Croatian companies including the metal giant Djuro Djakovic, machinery builder Prvomajska, furniture companies Exportdrvo and Savric, chocolate factory Kras and many others.
Croatia's exports to Canada totalled a meagre $8.2 million last year, less than half its imports, Dunja Konjevod, head of the foreign economic relations sector, said.
